hints.content:
$h'(x)>0$ means $h$ is **increasing**.

$h'(x)<0$ means $h$ is **decreasing**.

$h''(x)>0$ means the slope of $h$ is increasing ($h$ is **concave up**).

$h''(x)<0$ means the slope of $h$ is decreasing ($h$ is **concave down**).

| | $h'(x)>0$ | $h'(x)<0$
:- | :- | :-: | :-:
| | $h$ is **increasing** | $h$ is **decreasing**
$h''(x)>0$ | $h$ is **concave up** |  ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/fad1dc95cd761b6e7f4c581c7093841fcf16029a) | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/88e8d1ff71cbe909ea256814c06e1ff2df39bd5e)
$h''(x)<0$ | $h$ is **concave down** | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/f9425dbee4d4f73f6188a62f88f637018843d7c8) | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/4d64d76d6423a90abf605dfe2b856e7327f92a0c)

We are asked to find an interval where $h'(x)>0$ and $h''(x)>0$, so we need an interval where the graph of $h$ has this general shape:

 ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/fad1dc95cd761b6e7f4c581c7093841fcf16029a)

Now we can check each option:

Interval | Shape | Is $h'(x)>0$ and $h''(x)>0$?
:-: | :-: | :-:
$0<x<1$  | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/842593fcfd6a52a51cd66950f88ff7cd344d7af3) | $\greenD{\text{Yes!}}$
$0<x<2$ | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/842593fcfd6a52a51cd66950f88ff7cd344d7af3) | $\greenD{\text{Yes!}}$
$2<x<4$ | ![graph](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/842593fcfd6a52a51cd66950f88ff7cd344d7af3) | $\greenD{\text{Yes!}}$
